title: The institute’s fall intern has started her work in Riyadh
content:
FIME’s fall 2026 EDUFI intern, Essi Kupiainen, has started her work in Riyadh in the beginning of September.  

Essi is a master’s student in Global Development Studies at the University of Helsinki. Essi has also a minor in Middle Eastern Studies and Arabic. She has a bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences. In her studies, she is particularly interested in the themes of political geography, mundane infrastructures, violence and power. Essi’s goal during the internship is to collect material and to work on her master’s thesis. The internship in Riyadh offers a possibility to get a glimpse of the realities of doing research in the Middle East.  

“It is a great honor to become a part of the FIME team and to be able to get a closer look at the institute’s work. I am particularly eager to get to organize the institute’s events and to learn about the societies and histories of the Middle East through them. I also want to use the opportunity of being here to pursue my studies in Arabic.”

title: FIME to Visit Riyadh This Autumn
content:
This autumn, the Finnish Institute in the Middle East (FIME) will spend the autumn in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. During the four-month visit, FIME’s personnel will deepen their knowledge of the Gulf region, strengthen academic networks and explore new opportunities for cooperation.

FIME will organise a range of activities in Riyadh, including two academic workshops, public lectures, and a student course focusing on the ancient history of Saudi Arabia.

The Embassy of Finland in Riyadh has generously offered FIME workspace for the duration of the visit. FIME was invited to Saudi Arabia by the Gulf Research Center, while the Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Helsinki has assisted with the practical arrangements. The King Faisal Center for Research and Islamic Studies (KFCRIS) will provide seminar facilities for FIME’s events.

FIME warmly thanks all the organisations involved for their support and for making the visit possible!
